Home » Facilities » Class Rooms

Class Rooms

Room no: 112

Facilities available: The Classroom at CSA department is equipped with a ceiling-mounted LCD projector, a large 12ft x 10ft motorized screen, and a wireless audio system.

Seating Capacity: 80

Used for: Conducting Classes and Seminars.

Room no: 117

Facilities available: The E Classroom at CSA department is equipped with ceiling-mounted LCD projector, large 12ft x 10ft motorized screen, and wireless audio system.

Seating Capacity: 60

Used for: Conducting Classes and Seminars.

Room no: 104

Facilities available: CSA Auditorium is equipped with ceiling-mounted LCD projector, large motorized screen, and wireless audio system and camera.

Seating Capacity: 114

Used for: Seminars and Distinguished Lectures.

Room no: 254

Facilities available: CSA Seminar hall is equipped with ceiling-mounted LCD projector, large 12ft x 10ft motorized screen, and wireless audio system.

Seating Capacity: 80

Used for: Conducting Classes, Seminars and Distinguished Lectures.

Room no: 252

Facilities available: The Multimedia Classroom at CSA department is equiped with state-of-the-art facilities such as HD Video recorder for recording lectures, ceiling-mounted LCD projector, motorized screen, and wireless audio system.

Seating Capacity: 40

Used for: Conducting Classes and Seminars.

Room no: 101

Facilities available: CSA Faculty Room is equipped with LCD projector, motorized screen.

Seating Capacity: 25

Used for: Faculty meetings, and various oral exams such as Comprehensive exam, Project presentations etc.

Room no: 225

Facilities available: CSA Conference Room is equipped with LCD projector and Teleconferencing facilities.

Seating Capacity: 20

Used for: Conducting Classes, Presentation’s, Teleconferences and Faculty meetings.
